facts.textJa: ギブオンは、イスラエル人の近隣にあった四つの町の一つとして列挙される。
エルサレム王アドニ・ツェデクは、ギブオンがイスラエルと和を結んだと聞く。
本文はギブオンを王都に匹敵する大きな町と説明する。
王はギブオンを攻めるために軍を集める。
五王がギブオンに対して陣を敷き、戦った。
ギブオン人はギルガルのヨシュアに救援を求める。
主はイスラエルの前で敵を混乱させ、ギブオン付近から追い払う。
ギブオンにおける戦いの最中、ヨシュアが主に語りかけたと記される。
ギブオンはヨシュアが打った南部の範囲の北端として挙げられる。
ギブオン以外には、イスラエルと和を結んだ町はなかったと記される。
ベニヤミンの相続地に属する町としてギブオンが列挙される。

currentOccurrenceTexts.fixedText: But when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,
The children of Israel traveled and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath Jearim.

Now when Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them,
they were very afraid, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all its men were mighty.
“Come up to me and help me. Let’s strike Gibeon; for they have made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.”

Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together and went up, they and all their armies, and encamped against Gibeon, and made war against it.

The men of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, “Don’t abandon your servants! Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us; for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the hill country have gathered together against us.”
The LORD confused them before Israel. He killed them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them by the way of the ascent of Beth Horon, and struck them to Azekah and to Makkedah.

Then Joshua spoke to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel. He said in the sight of Israel, “Sun, stand still on Gibeon! You, moon, stop in the valley of Aijalon!”
Joshua struck them from Kadesh Barnea even to Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even to Gibeon.
There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. They took all in battle.

currentOccurrenceTexts.fixedText: “Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go across this Jordan, you and all these people, to the land which I am giving to them, even to the children of Israel.

“Pass through the middle of the camp, and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare food; for within three days you are to pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess.’”

Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall live in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan; but you shall pass over before your brothers armed, all the mighty men of valor, and shall help them

until the LORD has given your brothers rest, as he has given you, and they have also possessed the land which the LORD your God gives them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and possess it, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise.’”
The men pursued them along the way to the fords of the Jordan River. As soon as those who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate.

For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red Sea before you, when you came out of Egypt; and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and to Og, whom you utterly destroyed.
Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel. They camped there before they crossed over.
You shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, saying, ‘When you come to the brink of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.’”
Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passes over before you into the Jordan.

It shall be that when the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of GOD, the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, that the waters of the Jordan will be cut off. The waters that come down from above shall stand in one heap.”
When the people moved from their tents to pass over the Jordan, the priests who bore the ark of the covenant being before the people,

and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest),

The priests who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan.
When all the nation had completely crossed over the Jordan, the LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

and command them, saying, ‘Take from out of the middle of the Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, carry them over with you, and lay them down in the place where you’ll camp tonight.’”

Joshua said to them, “Cross before the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan, and each of you pick up a stone and put it on your shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel;

then you shall tell them, ‘Because the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the LORD’s covenant. When it crossed over the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. These stones shall be for a memorial to the children of Israel forever.’”

The children of Israel did as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the middle of the Jordan, as the LORD spoke to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel. They carried them over with them to the place where they camped, and laid them down there.
Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests who bore the ark of the covenant stood; and they are there to this day.

For the priests who bore the ark stood in the middle of the Jordan until everything was finished that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua; and the people hurried and passed over.
“Command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, that they come up out of the Jordan.”
Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, “Come up out of the Jordan!”

When the priests who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant had come up out of the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet had been lifted up to the dry ground, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place, and went over all its banks, as before.
The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, on the east border of Jericho.
Joshua set up those twelve stones, which they took out of the Jordan, in Gilgal.
Then you shall let your children know, saying, ‘Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

For the LORD your God dried up the waters of the Jordan from before you until you had crossed over, as the LORD your God did to the Red Sea, which he dried up from before us, until we had crossed over,

When all the kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, who were by the sea, heard how the LORD had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the children of Israel until we had crossed over, their heart melted, and there was no more spirit in them, because of the children of Israel.

Joshua said, “Alas, Lord GOD, why have you brought this people over the Jordan at all, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to cause us to perish? I wish that we had been content and lived beyond the Jordan!

When all the kings who were beyond the Jordan, in the hill country, and in the lowland, and on all the shore of the great sea in front of Lebanon, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard of it
and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.

Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:

These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them:
The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.

and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.
These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.
For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.
The east border was the Salt Sea, even to the end of the Jordan. The border of the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan.
The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.
It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.
Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;

However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.”
Their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan. The border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward. It ended at the wilderness of Beth Aven.
The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.
The Jordan was its border on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders around it, according to their families.
The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.
The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.

Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

Now the LORD your God has given rest to your brothers, as he spoke to them. Therefore now return and go to your tents, to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan.

Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given inheritance in Bashan; but Joshua gave to the other half among their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. Moreover when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them,

When they came to the region near the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, a great altar to look at.

The children of Israel heard this, “Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar along the border of the land of Canaan, in the region around the Jordan, on the side that belongs to the children of Israel.”

For the LORD has made the Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad. You have no portion in the LORD.”’ So your children might make our children cease from fearing the LORD.

Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.
“‘I brought you into the land of the Amorites, that lived beyond the Jordan. They fought with you, and I gave them into your hand. You possessed their land, and I destroyed them from before you.

“‘You went over the Jordan, and came to Jericho. The men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.

facts.textJa: エルサレム、ヘブロン、ヤルムト、ラキシュ、エグロンの王たちが集まり、ギベオンを攻める。
連合軍の五王が捕らえられてヨシュアの前に出され、その中にラキシュ王が含まれる。
ヨシュアはリブナからラキシュへ進み、包囲して戦い、二日目に町を取る。

後のユダの町一覧にもラキシュが記される。

ヨシュアはシロでくじを引き、相続地を分けた。
シロで、祭司エルアザル、ヨシュア、部族の長たちが相続地の配分を完了した。
レビ人の代表は、シロで町と放牧地を求めた。
ルベン、ガド、マナセ半部族は、シロからヨルダン川東側へ戻った。

currentOccurrenceTexts.fixedText: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.

The men arose and went. Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land, saying, “Go walk through the land, survey it, and come again to me. I will cast lots for you here before the LORD in Shiloh.”
The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.
Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.

These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.
They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “The LORD commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for our livestock.”

The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, which they owned, according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
When the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up against them to war.

currentOccurrenceTexts.fixedText: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.
Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.
It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.
From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.
The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;
Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,
The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.

currentOccurrenceTexts.fixedText: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,
Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;
Moses did as the LORD commanded. They went up onto Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.
They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.
They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

facts.textJa: 割当地の一覧は、ベト・ペオル、ピスガの斜面、ベト・エシモトを並べて記します。

wikipedia.title: Mount Pisgah (Bible)
wikipedia.noteJa: 記事はPisgahを山頂・高地名として扱い、ネボ山などとの関係を説明しますが、ヨシュア記12:3の斜面を特定しません。関連資料として示し、同一の峰や境界を確定する根拠にはしません。

mapPolicy.reasonJa: ヨシュア記12:3は「ピスガの斜面」を範囲の目印として記し、13:20も斜面を地名一覧に含める。従来資料の候補点は同じPisgah高地名の参考位置として保持できるが、斜面の範囲や単一峰を示す確定地点ではない。地図では「比定候補」と明示し、profile.coordinateはnullのままにする。

currentAlwaysVisibleFields.subtitleJa: 東岸の征服記録に現れる地形名
currentAlwaysVisibleFields.summaryJa: ヨシュア記12:3は、東岸の征服地域の南方を「ピスガの斜面の下」と記します。ここでは特定の山頂や町ではなく、ピスガの斜面を指す地名表現として扱います。
currentAlwaysVisibleFields.identityNoteJa: 民数記21:20の「ピスガの頂」と同じ地理名に関わりますが、ヨシュア記の「斜面」が同じ峰の一点を指すとは確定しません。
currentAlwaysVisibleFields.modernLocationJa: ヨルダン川東側、死海北東の高地群と結び付けられる地名です。個別の斜面の範囲や現代の峰との対応は確定しません。
currentAlwaysVisibleFields.historicalRoleJa: ヨシュア記12:3では東岸の地理的範囲を示す目印として現れます。
currentAlwaysVisibleFields.locationNoteJa: 本文は斜面という範囲を示し、境界線や一つの山頂の位置までは定めていません。

currentFacts.textJa: 割当地の一覧は、ベト・ペオル、ピスガの斜面、ベト・エシモトを並べて記します。

currentSnapshotUpdate.hashMethodCorrectionJa: 作者evidence.profileSHA256はjson.dumps(profile,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=False)で照合。sort_keys=Trueによる値との差をstaleとして数えた過去の比較は無効。draft全体SHAは独立に比較し、旧review保存SHAを取得できたものと区別した。
currentSnapshotUpdate.contentAuditStateJa: 現行Wikipedia URLについて、記事本文とprofile対象への適合を個別所見に記録し、ページ開封だけの状態と区別した。profile全項目の意味的passは未宣言。地理的比定・遺跡座標の独立検証は別途必要。

fixedTextAudit.semanticLimitJa: 自動検査は出典の存在・参照ゲート警告だけ。用例の固有地名性や文脈解釈の独立合格を意味しない。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chezib_of_.findingJa: 記事はユダのシェフェラのヨシュア15:44のアクジブとするが、Khirbet Sheikh GhaziとKhirbet Ein el-Kizbeの二遺跡候補で歴史地理家の見解が分かれる。fragmentなし。
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chezib_of_.anchorAssessment: article; direct biblical relation, site uncertain

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adummim.findingJa: ヨシュア15:7・18:17の「アドミムの上り坂」とする。エルサレム—エリコ間、Tal’at ed-Dumm説を挙げる一方、Pitkänenは正確な位置不明とする。点の同定は不確実。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afek#Place.findingJa: Afek曖昧さ回避に着地しfragmentなし。最終節にdisambiguationページと記す。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maacah.findingJa: 記事の主題は多数の人物名で、別用法にAram-Maacah王国・その王と領域がある。ヨシュア13:13のMaacath地方/人々をこの人物・王国記事で同一と断定できない。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_Sea.findingJa: 曖昧さ回避ページ。聖書でGreat Seaと呼ばれるのはMediterranean Seaと一項目に示すだけ。profileが地理として使うならrelatedリンクであり、対象記事 identity proof ではない。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aphek_(bib.findingJa: アシェルのAphik候補など複数地点。JOS13:4と19:30を同一点とは結論しない。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bethel#Boo.exactEvidence: Book of Joshua heading L195; body L199
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bethel#Boo.findingJa: ヨシュア7:2・8:9でアイ近く、16:1でルズに隣接と記す。古代ルズは元名という記事記述もある。Book of Joshua見出し/fragmentを確認。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tel_Beit_S.exactEvidence: Hebrew Bible heading L238; body L242
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tel_Beit_S.findingJa: 古代Beit Shemeshをヨシュア15:10のユダ領境界町、21:16の祭司の町と説明。現代テル/遺跡と聖書都市の関係は他の同名箇所を別途区別。指定見出しを確認。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dhiban,_Jo.findingJa: 現Dhibanは町と遺跡の両方を含む。さらに東シリアの同名Dibanと別記事。ページ自体にinline citation不足注意があるため、古代Dibonとの関連を独立証明とみなさず現市域とtellを分ける。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zarqa_Rive.exactEvidence: Biblical Jabbok heading L189; body L193–196
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zarqa_Rive.findingJa: 本文は現代Zarqa Riverを聖書のJabbokと明示し、ヤコブがハランからカナンへ戻る途中に渡った川、アモン人領とアモリ人領の境界として説明する。川名の関連は記事が支持するが、プロフィールに表示する河川全域の代表点や特定の渡河地点まではこの記事から確定しない。
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zarqa_Rive.anchorAssessment: fragment and passage-specific body confirmed; river relationship supported; exact route point not established

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rephidim#L.findingJa: Location見出しあり。今回確認した段落はWadi Feiran案と、Wadi Solaf/esh-Sheikhを通る行程案を述べる。直前レビューの複数候補不確定注意は維持し、fragmentは確認。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Pisg.findingJa: 本文はPisgahを「山名」とする訳と、語義summit/複数の頂がある地域、Neboを複数頂の最高峰として併記。記事自身出典不足注意。単一確定峰との断定を避ける。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cities_in_.pagesRead: Cities in the Book of Joshua
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cities_in_.findingJa: ページ冒頭はヨシュア記が約400名・300超の異なる場所を指すとし、部族ごとの一覧表を掲載。候補所在地は疑問符・複数案を含む。特定の表行やfragmentを示す場合はページ全体だけでは行の根拠にならない。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_mi.pagesRead: List of minor biblical places — En-haddah
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_mi.findingJa: ヨシュア19:21のイッサカル領の一町。近くのEn-gannimとの並びからその近辺という推測。指定見出し確認。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lifta.findingJa: 現代のパレスチナ村・エルサレム郊外のLiftaを扱う。Biblical identification節はMei Nephtoah同定を一説とし、別説にElephを挙げ、確実でないとする。現村と聖書境界泉を同一と断定しない。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ziph_(Bibl.findingJa: 記事はユダ族の山地、ヘブロン南東の町としてヨシュア15:55を直接挙げ、サムエル記上23章にも言及。今回の抜粋では現代の遺跡同定までは確認していない。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_mi.pagesRead: List of minor biblical places — Sebam
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_mi.findingJa: SebamはSibmahへの参照で、Sibmahはルベン領の町名・別本文ではMoabite city、所在地不明。指定fragmentはSebam小見出しから参照先へ繋がる。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hormah.findingJa: 記事は南カナンの未同定都市とする。Beer Sheba–Gaza間、Beer Sheba–Arad間、Arabah東側など複数候補を挙げ、町でなく地域説も紹介。座標一点は支持しない。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ashteroth_.findingJa: ページは東ヨルダン・バシャンの都市とし、もとはAshtarothとKarnaimが隣接する二都市、Ashtaroth衰退後にKarnaimが複合名を継いだという説明。Ashtaroth節見出しを確認。両者を最初から同一点と扱わない。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_mi.pagesRead: List of minor biblical places — Rumah
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_mi.findingJa: 同一記事が列王記下23:26の母の出身Rumahと、ヨシュア15:52のRumah/Dumahを別の用例として説明。後者のDūme同定にも不確かさ。別profile/用例の同名混同注意。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neiel.findingJa: ヨシュア19:27にあるアシェル南境の町とする短いstub記事で、現代同定情報は示さない。直接の聖書関連は確認できる。
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neiel.anchorAssessment: article; direct textual identity, no modern site

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arnon.findingJa: 語句出現は川をSee alsoに指すが現URLは人名セット索引なので現profileのWikiidentityVerifiedは誤り。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joshua_17#.findingJa: 指定のAllotment for Manasseh見出しを確認。解説はマナセ領を東西ヨルダンに分け、境界や氏族を説明するが、profileの個別地名を同定する根拠ではなく章の二次解説として扱うべき。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_mi.pagesRead: List of minor biblical places — Ataroth-addar
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_mi.findingJa: Ataroth-addarはヨシュア16:5の地名で、同16:2のAtarothと同一かもしれないと記す。指定fragment見出しを確認。

fullCurrentClosure.closureRationaleJa: Aphik (Asher)・Wadi Mujibの差替えとGolan初出修正は現稿で確認済み。61件の変更差分も再読した。ただし4件の上記blocking findingsが残るため、現行191件の全面closureとはしない。
fullCurrentClosure.remainingLimitsJa: places_1現稿に上記4件の未解消failあり（3件の読者表示内部工程語、ShihorのWikipedia fragment/内容不一致）。他187件はqualified。現行位置/遺跡比定の全件独立地理検証は未実施であり、プロフィール座標nullは不適合としない。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aphik_(Ash.exactEvidence: 本文L113: Asher tribal city; at least three identifications/alternatives; article displays no-citation warning L111.
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aphik_(Ash.findingJa: 現行draftのリンク先。本文はAphik/Afikをアシェル族の聖書上の町とし、Aphaca/modern AfkaまたはTel Afek近郊等の複数同定を挙げるが、記事自身に出典不足注意がある。関連性はあるが個別profileの同定証明ではない。

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wadi_Mujib.exactEvidence: L147 river in Jordan; L207 says Arnon Stream in biblical times and cites Numbers boundary narrative.
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wadi_Mujib.findingJa: 現行draftのリンク先。本文はWadi Mujibを古代のArnon Streamと記し、歴史節で聖書Numbers 21:13–26と領域境界を説明する。川谷/水系としてのrelated identityを支え、遺跡の特定座標は与えない。

wikiReadCoverage.limitsJa: 現行115 unique URLすべてを実際に開き、記事本文の具体的所見を記録した。指定fragment・記事対象・profile claimの適合は別に注記し、本文閲覧だけで同一性証明としない。Besor説を記す日本語記事は目次見出しとL141–145で実在・内容を再確認。profile.coordinateの全件独立地理照合を行ったわけではない。

qualificationSplit.criteriaJa: AはWEB本文・全記録用例・常時表示欄/factsを確認し、Wikipedia採用時は実記事本文も読んだ上で、残余が不確定な古代比定/候補地/地域範囲等の明示的留保であるprofile。Bはprofile自体の原典名照合、後発profileの全面照合、または指定記事fragment/同一性主張の証拠に未解決箇所があるprofile。FAILは現行読者表示または記事根拠の具体的誤りとして別計上。

evidenceHashCorrectionThisUpdate.methodJa: 現行evidence profileSHA256 191/191はsort_keys=Falseの作者規定方式で現物profileと一致。過去のsort_keys=True比較による80件のstale警告はfalse positiveであり、履歴欄へ移した。draft全体SHAの現物一致とは別に扱う。

authorFieldReclosureThisUpdate.basisJa: current draft/evidence were re-read from filesystem. Jagur row was located directly; Almon Diblathaim/Bene Jaakan language changes remove internal-workflow wording; Shihor URL was reopened at exact Japanese article fragment and its actual section text confirms the Besor identification theory. The prior Shihor fail was reviewer misread, not an author correction.

currentSnapshotUpdate.remainingLimitsJa: 現行191件の固定WEB出現・欄・採用Wikipedia本文の確認を実施。profile座標/既存候補点を独立した考古学・地理資料で全件検証したものではなく、古代/現代同定の不確かさはqualifiedで維持。現時点で未解消のfailはない。

qualificationReviewClosuresThisUpdate.resolutionJa: Cities in the Book of JoshuaのEder行を本文L364で実見し、Joshua15:21とユダ/Edom境界の関連を確認。旧Bの行確認漏れを閉じてAへ。
日本語Negev記事の現行JOSリンクを区別して実読。英語NUM稿の未確認#Biblical fragment懸念を誤適用していたため、JOSはA。

現行記事はGaza Cityが少なくとも紀元前15世紀から居住された都市であり、後代のAzzatu、エジプト統治、ペリシテ五都市等の歴史を述べる。Tell es-Sakan/Tell el-Ajjul等の別の古代遺跡も区別する。現プロフィールは地理的連続を述べる一方、古代/現代の市域を同一視せず、identityVerified=trueは都市史上の関連という範囲なら記事に根拠あり。遺跡の正確な位置は未確定。
指定History節は実在。記事は現代キブツがナフタリの聖書のIronにちなみ、IronはレバノンのYarounとよく同定されると記す。現profileは現代キブツと古代村を分離しrelated-section/identityVerified=falseと正確に限定。
指定のBiblical subsectionは目次に実在し、リンク先本文は聖書のNegev/Negebが現代Negevの最北部だけであった可能性と、別の「south」用法を説明する。現profileの#Biblical linkおよび関連節・範囲未確定のnoteと合う。
固定WEBのNUM14:45はAmalekites/CanaanitesがIsraelをHormahまで打ち返したこと、21:3はそのplace-nameを記す。profileは14:45を初出/summary、21:3を後続factとして正しく分離。記事は両節と複数の現代候補・地区説を具体的に挙げる。coordinate nullで正確な場所を確定しない説明が妥当。

currentSnapshotUpdate.closureNoteJa: 2026-10-15 current closure: explicit exclusions and JOS Pisgah policy checked against current on-disk JSON; all 192 draft/evidence hashes recomputed.

row.reasonJa: ヨシュア記12:3は「ピスガの斜面」を範囲の目印として記し、13:20も斜面を地名一覧に含める。従来資料の候補点は同じPisgah高地名の参考位置として保持できるが、斜面の範囲や単一峰を示す確定地点ではない。地図では「比定候補」と明示し、profile.coordinateはnullのままにする。

finalClosure.noteJa: 全192稿の現行ファイルSHAとprofile/evidence SHAを再計算。3件は固定本文に当該地名がなく明示excludedのため受理profile数から除外し、除外記録として閉じた。JOS Pisgahはbook別候補方針を確認し旧指摘を閉じた。189件は地理候補の未確定性が明示されたqualified。
